title: Why Technology Still Matters with Marc Andreessen

reader_summary.headline: If a lot of smart people are working on something, it's like virtually guaranteed that it's going to happen.
reader_summary.overview: If a lot of smart people are working on something, it's like virtually guaranteed that it's going to happen, it's just a question of when. The A16C podcast is back, and this is your new host, Seth Smith. I'm so excited to explore the world of technology with you through the lens of the builders shaping it.

And perhaps even more important, who is going to build this next generation of technology and what needs to be done to enable those founders and builders?

key_points.text: And I'm a little biased, but who better to traverse this ground than A16C's co-founder and general partner, Mark Andresen.
key_points.evidence_quote: And I'm a little biased, but who better to traverse this ground than A16C's co-founder and general partner, Mark Andresen, someone who is not only built but also invested invested in the future time and time again, especially when it was not the obvious thing to do.

thesis: The podcast argues that technology is the sole driver of human progress, transforming life from a state of misery and subsistence to one of improvement by providing leverage through tools. It further posits that the historical narrative of past eras being idyllic is a fantasy, as recorded civilization has only existed for roughly 4,000 years of humanity's existence.
